title: inbox\settings.json schema 3 (DRAFT): two profile counts, per-profile shares, host reserve
x-owner: P12 (supervisor reader and both contract docs); P20 (tray writer); schema 2 stays the live contract until P12 lands

linux_backend.description: Supervisor-side; the tray writes back what status.v5.json reports and never changes it. Flipped only by the cutover item P27. Default wsl-legacy.

runner_count.description: The Linux count, as in schema 2 (now 0 allowed when Windows >= 1).

job_cpus.description: Legacy WSL pool total, unchanged meaning; the supervisor caps it to the Linux share (shares win); ignored while runner_count is 0 or linux_backend is hyperv-vm.

lease_wall_clock_hours.description: Host cap per VM lease, default 6. Past it a quarantined slot whose runner GitHub reports offline is destroyed; a runner GitHub reports busy is never destroyed, only flagged in status.
